Name: Fs vv's HD Cute Face Pack
Author: sutian
Description:
[center]这是一个关于FS模组，你需要去皮埃尔那里购买手镜，然后通过手镜获取这些东西。(需要Fashion Sense前置）[/center]
[center]为星露谷添置了新的高清脸部面具，有两个肤色可供选择，以及一些新增加可选耳朵，和三个高清眼睛美化。[/center]
[center]一些其他配件：[/center]
[center]两个脸蛋腮红，两个鼻尖腮红，一个嘴巴。[/center]
[center]方便大家自行搭配使用[/center]
[center][b][color=#ffff00]（图片展示的头发和头饰不包含在里面，这只是一个脸部面具模组）[/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]

[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]SMAPI， Fashion sense [/size][/color][/center]
[center][b][size=5]安装[/size][/b][/center]
[center][color=#e69138][size=4]1.请下载并安装好所有前置。（必要）[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#e69138][size=4]2.下载下来是压缩包，请解压后使用。[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#e69138][size=4]3.请将解压后的文件夹放入“Mods”[/size][/color][/center]
[center]
[b]This is a mod for Fashion Sense.[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]You need to buy a Hand Mirror from Pierre, then use it to obtain all the contents in this mod.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][b]Requires Fashion Sense as a prerequisite.[/b][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]This mod adds new high-definition face masks for Stardew Valley, with two skin tone options, new optional ears, and three high-quality eye overwrites.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Extra accessories included: two cheek blushes, two nose blushes, and one mouth preset.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#ffff00]The hair and headwear shown in the preview images are not included. This is only a facial mask mod,[/color][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]for you to freely mix and match with other mods.[/center]
